title: Fixed Capped Wind Tube and Upturned Open Crook
description: One newly authored whole crumhorn-inspired fixed wind-instrument appearance. A single continuous finite-wall J-shaped wooden-look tube has seven true polygonal front finger ports, a rounded lower return with a short finite bottom resting facet, and one open upturned mouth. Its entire hollow socketed wind cap narrows to a real small oval top slot; the cap seats around the upper body and two whole annular alloy-look bands finish the cap root and crook end. Every body coordinate and port layout is newly authored, not a bent old blockflute, reused bassoon boot or separate horn assembly. One model zero scenes, four opaque PBR roles, metres and native Z up. Broad capped-reed/J-shaped category inspiration only, not an exact historical or branded instrument; hidden reed not modeled. No sound, pitch, working airflow, fingering accuracy, tuning, breath pressure, flexible bending, manufacture, playability, handling, equilibrium or safety capability. No rig, animation or interaction.
